entities.summary: Courtney Fells is an American professional basketball player who last played for KK Kvarner 2010 of the HT Premijer liga in Croatia. He has previously played for Hoops Club in Lebanon and Club Atlético Aguada in Uruguay. He attended and played college basketball for NC State university.
